确认这句只有本人说话？: Is this phrase only your voice?
先回听确认是你独自清晰说话，再将本句作为声纹样本。手表录音可补充不同麦克风特征；: Listen first and confirm only you are speaking clearly. A watch sample can help with microphone differences. Your existing profile is kept and audio stays local. Avoid multiple voices, overlap and noise.
原文或音频已更新，请刷新后重试: The transcript or audio has changed. Refresh and try again.
已补充本人声纹，可点击重新匹配声纹，保留原文。: Sample added. Match speakers again to update labels while keeping the transcript.
只重新匹配声纹，保留文字、时间和已确认的说话人。: Update automatic speaker labels while keeping text, timestamps and confirmed speakers.
发送当前原文与本地人声检测统计，不附原始音频或传感器历史。: Send the transcript and local speech detection statistics, without original audio or sensor history.
发送当前原文、本地人声检测统计，以及你所选这段录音的心率、气压、光照观察。: Send the transcript, local speech detection statistics and heart rate, pressure and light observations for this recording.
请先试听，再核对是否删除。: Listen first, then review deletion options.
仅列出本地未检出人声或 LLM 建议清理的片段；不会自动删除。: Shows recordings with no detected speech or an LLM cleanup suggestion. Nothing is deleted automatically.
手机与手表麦克风可能存在差异。可在手表录音详情回听后，用清晰的本人单人语句补充声: Phone and watch microphones can differ. After listening to a watch recording, add a clear phrase with only your voice from its details. Then match speakers again without transcribing again. Labels are suggestions and never train your profile automatically.
有效语音过短，请选择更长的本人语音: Too little speech. Choose a longer phrase with your voice.
样本声音差异较大，请在安静环境只录本人声音: The sample varies too much. Record only your own voice in a quiet place.
请重新转写以恢复精简音频时间映射: Transcribe again to restore the retained audio time mapping.
请选择一段 3–30 秒清晰的本人语音: Choose 3–30 seconds of your own clear speech.
该片段音频不可用: Audio for this segment is unavailable.
LLM 根据转写与本地检测统计提出建议，未试听原音。: The LLM suggested this from text and local detection statistics. It has not listened to the audio.
请先完成逐段转写，再重新匹配声纹: Transcribe into timed segments before matching speakers again.
